packageRules.description: Keep pnpm on 10.x while this repo supports Node 18; pnpm 11 requires Node 22.13 or newer.
Keep better-sqlite3 on 12.x while this repo's CI matrix tests Node 20; better-sqlite3 13 requires Node >=22.
Allow caret ranges for production dependencies (this is a library, not an app) so Renovate bumps them without repinning to exact versions.
